trees.note: Opened by the ask-outing rule. While the follower is waiting for an answer this REPLACES the everyday Talk-to script, so walking over and talking to it is how you answer - no magic word typed into public chat, and no follower listening to the whole street. The node carrying "answer" is what feeds the reply back to the rules: yes puts a want on the board, no closes it politely.

says: I wanted to ask you something, and I'd rather ask it properly.
Have you got time to go somewhere with me? Nowhere far. Just somewhere I like.
We go where you need to go. That's the arrangement, and I've no complaints about it.
But there are places I'd go if it were up to me, and it never is.

you: All right. Where did you have in mind?

says: Give me a moment. I'll think of somewhere.
